              …

faqs.a:
(a)
No later than 30 days after the transfer of ownership of a pawnshop, or of the transfer
               of ownership of any of the capital stock of the corporation, the new owner of the
               stock or business shall file with the city clerk a written report of the transfer
               on forms provided by the city clerk. The report shall be accompanied by an investigation
               fee of $250.00.
(b)
Upon receipt of the report of transfer, the city clerk may, after investigation by
               the chief of police approve or deny the transfer. Criteria for approval shall be as
               for an original application. The city clerk shall consider the character of the proposed
               new owner and whether the new owner complies with all requirements of the Code and
               rules and regulation adopted pursuant to the Code. If the new owner is not approved,
               the license may be revoked.
(Code 1981, § 23-8; Ord. No. 3238, § 1, 12-18-1995)
